[]{.fragment .gd2-frag id="gd2-unrotate"}

```{=html}
<script>
/* Pair the code block's highlight steps with the animation's own steps, so one
   arrow press moves both. Quarto emits the fragments in document order, which
   would otherwise mean 13 presses instead of 8. Reveal reads
   data-fragment-index at sync time, so set them and re-sync.

   Step 1 lay, 2 explode, 3..6 one layer each, 7 collapse, 8 unrotate.
   The code block has five fragments: line 1, line 2, line 3, lines 4-9, and a
   final one that clears the highlight as the stack rejoins. */
(function wait() {
  var sec = document.querySelector('section.gd2-slide');
  if (typeof Reveal === 'undefined' || !Reveal.sync || !sec) { setTimeout(wait, 50); return; }
  var code = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7], i = 0;
  sec.querySelectorAll('.gd2-listing .fragment').forEach(function (el) {
    if (i < code.length) el.setAttribute('data-fragment-index', code[i++]);
  });
  var gd2 = {'gd2-lay': 1, 'gd2-explode': 2, 'gd2-f1': 3, 'gd2-f2': 4,
             'gd2-f3': 5, 'gd2-f4': 6, 'gd2-collapse': 7, 'gd2-unrotate': 8};
  Object.keys(gd2).forEach(function (id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.setAttribute('data-fragment-index', gd2[id]);
  });
  Reveal.sync();
})();
</script>
```
